about: Golden evaluation cases for Claim Sense. Expected values are worked out by hand from the synthetic policy wording and terms (data/policies), not copied from system output. Run: python scripts/evaluate.py

claims.title: Gastroenteritis admission, every check passes; only the deductible and co-pay apply
claims.working: 25,000 billed; room rent 4,000/day is within the 5,000 limit (2.2); deductible 5,000 (5.1) -> 20,000; co-pay 10% (5.2) = 2,000 -> 18,000.

claims.title: Motor claim with a positive breath analyser test
claims.working: Police report says the driver was under the influence of alcohol; exclusion 3.1 applies, nothing is payable.

claims.title: Cataract surgery inside the 24-month specified-disease waiting period
claims.working: Policy started 2025-02-10, surgery 2025-09-05, about 6 months of cover; cataract needs 24 months (3.3).

claims.title: Appendicectomy with a room above the per-day limit and non-payable consumables
claims.working: 106,600 billed; consumables 3,400 not payable (4.3); room 3 days x (6,500 - 5,000) = 4,500 over the limit (2.2); deductible 5,000; co-pay 10% of 93,700 = 9,370 -> 84,330.

claims.title: Motor rear-end collision with depreciation by part type and vehicle age
claims.working: 73,500 billed; vehicle 34 months old so metal 15%: bumper 50% of 12,000 = 6,000, boot lid 15% of 26,000 = 3,900, tail lamp 50% of 6,500 = 3,250, paint 50% of 6,000 = 3,000 (2.2); glass and labour 0%; 1197cc deductible 2,000 (2.3) -> 55,350.

claims.title: Dengue admission without a discharge summary
claims.working: Required documents (6.2) include the discharge summary, which is missing. Provisional amount: 43,400 - 5,000 = 38,400, co-pay 3,840 -> 34,560.

claims.title: ICU pneumonia claim: early, 94% of the sum insured, and the form amount differs from the bill
Fracture before 2025-04-01, so the older wording's lower room limit and higher deductible apply
Road accident with bills above the sum insured; payment capped at the available sum insured
claims.working: 410,000 billed; room and ICU at exactly their limits; deductible 5,000 -> 405,000; co-pay 40,500 -> 364,500; capped at the 300,000 sum insured (5.3). 410,000 / 300,000 is above 80%, the only risk signal (score 30, MEDIUM).

claims.title: Second claim for the same appendicitis admission
claims.working: Same policy, incident date and amount as CLM-H-1001, which was filed first.

claims.title: Admission on 2025-04-01, the first day of the 2025.1 wording
Same bill admitted on 2025-03-31, the last day of the 2024.1 wording
Home fire loss with contents depreciation and the average clause for underinsurance
claims.working: 450,000 assessed; depreciation 20% on refrigerator 58,000 and microwave 14,000 (11,600 + 2,800) and 10% on sofa set 66,000 (6,600) = 21,000 (2.2) -> 429,000; value at risk 30,00,000 exceeds sum insured 25,00,000 by 20%, more than 15%, so average applies (2.3): 429,000 x 25/30 = 357,500, a cut of 71,500; excess 10,000 (4.1) -> 347,500.

claims.title: Burglary with unscheduled jewellery, electronics depreciation and the excess
claims.working: 305,000 assessed; gold jewellery 140,000 not covered unless scheduled (3.5) -> 165,000; depreciation 20% on laptop 85,000 and television 62,000 = 17,000 + 12,400 = 29,400 (2.2) -> 135,600; value at risk 11,00,000 is below the 12,00,000 sum insured, no average; excess 10,000 -> 125,600. FIR present as 5.2 requires for burglary.

claims.title: Home damage from long-term seepage and gradual deterioration
claims.working: Surveyor attributes the damage to seepage and gradual deterioration of waterproofing; exclusion 3.1 applies, nothing is payable.

claims.title: Emergency appendicectomy abroad with personal comfort items
claims.working: 442,500 billed in Singapore during the trip 2025-09-01 to 2025-09-20 (1.3); telephone and toiletries 3,500 not payable (2.4) -> 439,000; deductible 5,000 (4.1) -> 434,000; well within the 40,00,000 sum insured. Medical report present as 5.2 requires.

claims.title: Lost checked baggage above the per-item and per-trip limits
Ankle fracture from paragliding abroad
claims.working: Injury sustained while paragliding; hazardous sports exclusion 3.2 applies, nothing is payable.

claims.title: Baggage claim without the airline's property irregularity report
claims.working: 5.2 requires the airline's property irregularity report for a baggage claim and none was uploaded; the assessable amount would be 43,000 - 5,000 deductible = 38,000, but information is requested first.

claims.title: Storm damage to the roof; only the excess applies
claims.working: 71,000 of building repairs, no depreciation on building repairs (2.2); value at risk 16,00,000 is below the 18,00,000 sum insured; excess 10,000 (4.1) -> 61,000.

claims.title: Trip cancelled by an airport closure, above the cancellation limit
claims.working: Non-refundable airfare 112,000 + hotel 68,000 = 180,000; trip cancellation limit 1,50,000 (2.2) -> 150,000; deductible 5,000 -> 145,000.

claims.title: Treatment three days after the insured trip ended
claims.working: Trip 2026-02-02 to 2026-02-09; treatment on 2026-02-12 is after the return date, outside the period of cover (1.3), although the annual policy is in force.

claims.title: Caesarean delivery under the maternity exclusion
claims.working: Discharge summary records a full term pregnancy delivered by caesarean section; maternity and childbirth are excluded (4.4), nothing is payable.

claims.title: Motor accident with the driver's licence expired
claims.working: Police report records that the driver's licence expired on 2024-12-31, before the accident on 2025-10-03; exclusion 3.2 applies, nothing is payable.

claims.title: Burglary while the home had been unoccupied for about 95 days
claims.working: Surveyor records the premises unoccupied for about 95 days, more than the 60 consecutive days in 3.3; the burglary is not payable.

claims.title: Heart condition abroad that was under treatment before departure
claims.working: Claim form and medical report describe coronary artery disease under treatment before departure; pre-existing conditions are excluded (3.1), nothing is payable.

claims.title: Rhinoplasty for appearance
claims.working: Discharge summary records a cosmetic rhinoplasty for an aesthetic concern; cosmetic treatment is excluded (4.1), nothing is payable.

claims.title: Head injury while intoxicated
claims.working: Diagnosis is acute alcohol intoxication; treatment arising from alcohol is excluded (4.2), nothing is payable.

claims.title: Investigational stem cell therapy
claims.working: Procedure is an investigational stem cell therapy under a research protocol; experimental treatment is excluded (4.5).

claims.title: Typhoid 14 days after the policy started
claims.working: Policy started 2025-06-01, admission 2025-06-15: 14 days, inside the 30-day initial waiting period for illness (3.1); typhoid is not an accident.

claims.title: Diabetic foot 14 months into cover, diabetes declared at proposal
claims.working: Policy started 2024-09-01, admission 2025-11-10: about 14 months of cover; diabetes was declared at proposal, so the 36-month pre-existing disease waiting period applies (3.2).

claims.title: Engine seizure from mechanical breakdown
claims.working: Police report records no accident and a mechanical breakdown from oil starvation; wear, tear and breakdown are excluded (3.3).

claims.title: Collision while driving in Nepal
claims.working: Collision near Pokhara, Nepal; loss arising outside India is excluded (3.4).

claims.title: Fire deliberately set by the insured
claims.working: Fire investigation found the fire deliberately set by the insured; wilful acts are excluded (3.2).

claims.title: Damage recorded as an act of war
claims.working: The district administration recorded the shelling as an act of war; war risks are excluded (3.4).

claims.title: Fall from a balcony while intoxicated abroad
claims.working: Claim form and medical report record the insured intoxicated; claims arising under the influence of alcohol are excluded (3.3).

claims.title: Trip taken against medical advice after surgery
claims.working: Insured travelled against medical advice two weeks after surgery; such trips are excluded (3.4).

claims.title: SUV above 1500cc: depreciation and the higher deductible
claims.working: 82,000 billed; car first registered 2024-03-15, loss 2025-11-20: 20 months, so metal depreciation 10% (2.2): bonnet 34,000 -> 3,400; plastic 50%: bumper 7,500, headlamp 6,000, grille 2,000; paint 50%: 3,500; labour nil. Total 22,400 -> 59,600; 1956cc is above 1500cc, deductible 3,500 (2.3) -> 56,100.

claims.title: Malicious damage without a police report
claims.working: 4.1 requires a police report (FIR) for malicious damage and none was uploaded. Assessable amount: 33,000 - paint depreciation 50% of 9,000 = 4,500 -> 28,500 - deductible 2,000 (1197cc) = 26,500. Risk: loss 84 days after start (early claim, 20) + missing document (10) = 30, MEDIUM.

claims.title: House largely destroyed by fire after lightning: capped at the sum insured
claims.working: 11,60,000 assessed; depreciation 20% on refrigerator 60,000 = 12,000 and 10% on sofa 50,000 = 5,000 (2.2) -> 11,43,000; value at risk 11,00,000 is within 15% of the 10,00,000 sum insured, no average (2.3); excess 10,000 -> 11,33,000; capped at the sum insured 10,00,000 (1.2). Risk: claim is 116% of the sum insured (30), MEDIUM.

claims.title: Hospital treatment abroad without the treating doctor's report
claims.working: 5.2 requires a medical report from the treating doctor for a medical claim and none was uploaded. Assessable amount: 68,000 - deductible 5,000 = 63,000; information is requested first.

claims.title: Hernia repair after the 24-month specified-disease wait
claims.working: 81,000 billed; room 4,500/day is within the 5,000 limit (2.2); hernia treated 29 months after cover began on 2023-03-01, past the 24-month wait (3.3); deductible 5,000 (5.1) -> 76,000; co-pay 10% (5.2) = 7,600 -> 68,400.

claims.title: Severe dengue with ICU charged above the per-day limit
claims.working: 94,000 billed; ICU 3 days at 14,000 against the 10,000 limit (2.3) = 12,000 not payable -> 82,000; room 5,000/day is at the limit (2.2); deductible 5,000 -> 77,000; co-pay 10% = 7,700 -> 69,300.

claims.title: Road accident 11 days into cover: the initial wait does not apply
claims.working: 80,000 billed; admitted 11 days after commencement, but the 30-day initial waiting period does not apply to an accident (3.1); room 3,500/day within the limit; deductible 5,000 -> 75,000; co-pay 10% = 7,500 -> 67,500. Risk: early claim (20) only, LOW.

claims.title: Known hypertension after the 36-month pre-existing disease wait
claims.working: 48,000 billed; hypertension declared at proposal, admitted 45 months after cover began on 2022-01-10, past the 36-month wait (3.2); admission kit and consumables 2,000 not payable (4.3); room 6,000/day against 5,000 for 3 days = 3,000 (2.2) -> 43,000; deductible 5,000 -> 38,000; co-pay 10% = 3,800 -> 34,200.

claims.title: Admission three weeks after the policy lapsed
claims.working: The policy ran from 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30 and was not renewed; the admission on 2025-07-20 falls outside the policy period, and 2.1 covers hospitalisation during the policy period only.

claims.title: Car over five years old: 40% depreciation on metal parts
claims.working: 47,000 billed; first registered 2019-06-15, loss 2025-08-25: 74 months, so metal depreciation 40% (2.2): door panel 24,000 -> 9,600; plastic 50%: mirror 2,500; glass nil; paint 50%: 2,500; labour nil. Total 14,600 -> 32,400; deductible 2,000 (1197cc, 2.3) -> 30,400.

claims.title: Flood damage to a car parked in a basement
claims.working: Flood is an insured peril (2.1). 68,000 billed; first registered 2023-02-10, loss 2025-07-28: 29 months, metal 15%: floor panel 20,000 -> 3,000; plastic 50%: wiring harness 7,000, bumper 6,000; paint 50%: 2,000; labour nil. Total 18,000 -> 50,000; deductible 2,000 (1497cc) -> 48,000.

claims.title: New car under six months old, above 1500cc
claims.working: 69,000 billed; first registered 2025-06-20, loss 2025-11-08: 4 months, so nil depreciation on the boot lid (2.2); plastic 50%: bumper 8,000, tail lamp 4,500; paint 50%: 3,000. Total 15,500 -> 53,500; 1598cc is above 1500cc, deductible 3,500 (2.3) -> 50,000.

claims.title: Malicious damage reported to the police
claims.working: The police report 4.1 asks for is attached, unlike C39. 48,000 billed; first registered 2022-09-01, loss 2025-12-03: 39 months, metal 25%: door panel 16,000 -> 4,000; windshield glass nil; paint 50%: 4,000. Total 8,000 -> 40,000; deductible 2,000 (1199cc) -> 38,000.

claims.title: Burst water tank pipe flooded the ground floor
claims.working: Sudden bursting of a water tank pipe is an insured peril (2.1), unlike gradual seepage (C15). 1,39,000 assessed; depreciation 10% on the wardrobe 30,000 = 3,000 and 20% on the washing machine 34,000 = 6,800 (2.2) -> 1,29,200; value at risk 16,00,000 is within 15% of the 15,00,000 sum insured, no average (2.3); excess 10,000 -> 1,19,200.

claims.title: Cyclone damage to an underinsured home
claims.working: 1,45,000 assessed; depreciation 20% on the air conditioner unit 45,000 = 9,000 (2.2) -> 1,36,000; value at risk 10,00,000 is more than 15% above the 8,00,000 sum insured, so the loss is reduced to 8/10 (2.3): 1,08,800, a cut of 27,200; excess 10,000 -> 98,800.

claims.title: Earthquake cracked the walls and toppled contents
claims.working: 1,68,000 assessed; depreciation 10% on the cabinet and bookshelf 18,000 = 1,800 and 20% on the television 36,000 = 7,200 (2.2) -> 1,59,000; value at risk 21,00,000 is within 15% of the 20,00,000 sum insured (2.3); excess 10,000 -> 1,49,000.

claims.title: Trip cut short by a death in the family
claims.working: Death of an immediate family member is a cause the trip cancellation benefit names (2.2). Unused non-refundable hotel 54,000 + rebooked flight 38,000 = 92,000, within the 1,50,000 limit; deductible 5,000 (4.1) -> 87,000.

claims.title: Heart attack abroad: large emergency medical claim
claims.working: 8,49,000 of emergency treatment (2.1) with no heart disease before travel; telephone and laundry 4,000 not payable (2.4) -> 8,45,000; medical treatment has no sub-limit; deductible 5,000 -> 8,40,000, well within the 40,00,000 sum insured.

claims.title: Lost baggage inside the per-item and per-trip limits
claims.working: Every item is at most 25,000 and the total 69,000 is below the 1,00,000 baggage limit (2.3), so nothing is cut (compare C17); the airline's irregularity report is attached; deductible 5,000 -> 64,000.

claims.title: Scooter accident abroad with an ambulance transfer
claims.working: 1,85,500 billed for emergency treatment of an accidental injury including the ambulance (2.1); toiletries and laundry 1,500 not payable (2.4) -> 1,84,000; deductible 5,000 -> 1,79,000.
